visualReview.scope: Portable rendering, visibility and material fallback review. This is not maximum-fidelity acceptance.
visualReview.notes: Inspected the lit preview, all four turntable angles and four close-ups. The unequal bay silhouette, white/red shaft, lantern framing, domes, davit, ladder rungs, plate seams and rivets render coherently. Neutral turntables are dark on the black plinth; the shared close-up exposes both rails and rungs. Porthole apertures and junction detailing remain fidelity work.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all nine viewer frames, including the top-down placement fixture and full-size gallery/ladder close-ups. Painted metal and wood each load once through the canonical shared graph resolver. No browser errors; unloaded geometry count returns to zero. Flat fixture ground is not representative of the offshore site.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-identity OSM node and 2019 survey agree on the offshore anchor. Survey directions fix the south, WNW and NE bays with heading zero; local tip transforms to +28.90 m at the proposed -2.05 m datum. The flat fixture confirms these transforms. Actual water datum, tides, plan fit and later relocation still need review.

fidelityReview.notes: Initial individually authored 2018–2019 exterior. Refine true porthole wall apertures, bay/gallery joins, caisson plan and small fittings against the survey. Plate/rivet spacing and fittings are reconstructed; lantern optics, interiors, buried foundations and exact corrosion are absent. Do not count as a completed maximum-fidelity replica.
